newsitem.title: UK: BFI leaps 31 points on strong Panamax grain rates.
newsitem.headline: BFI leaps 31 points on strong Panamax grain rates.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) surged a further 31 points higher on Monday to 1,176 points as Panamax rates were driven up by strong demand from grain charterers in the North Atlantic and the trend showed little signs of slowing.

Brokers said Cargill were reported to have fixed 60,000 heavy grain USGulf to Amsterdam on Polish tonnage for end October at a much stronger $12 and a number of private timecharter fixtures within the Atlantic and from USGulf to Far East have been concluced at higher levels.
Dorval were reported to gave fixed Torm Marina 69,637 dwt delivery Gibraltar early Nov for a grain trip via USGulf to Taiwan at a firmer $12,250 daily.
Meanwhile Caper rates remained stagnant and Handies were firmer in the N.Atlantic but largely unchanged elsewhere.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX had strengthened by between five and 24 points and turnover totalled 187 lots.
